title: UK Corporation Tax rules (draft for verification)
status: DRAFT - imported UNVERIFIED; a holder of tax:rule-verify who did not import it checks each rule against its source and verifies it in the platform

source.provision: CTA 2010 Part 3A ss 18A-18N (small profits rate, limits, marginal relief), inserted by FA 2021 s 7 and Sch 1; main rate FA 2021 s 6

rules.verifierNote: Check the main rate (25%) and the small profits rate (19%) against the charge for each financial year from FY2023 (FA 2021 s 6 for FY2023; the later Finance Acts charge each later year). Check the lower and upper limits (£50,000 and £250,000, for a 12-month period with no associated companies) and the standard marginal relief fraction 3/200. If a later year changes any figure, end this version on 31 March of the last year it covers and enter the new one. HMRC summary: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/rates-and-allowances-corporation-tax

source.provision: CTA 2009 s 10(1)(a): an accounting period ends on the expiry of 12 months from its beginning

rules.verifierNote: Check that a CT accounting period ends no later than 12 months from its start (CTA 2009 s 10(1)(a)). The platform splits a longer accounts year into a first period of 12 months from the year's start and a second period for the rest (HMRC Company Taxation Manual CTM01405).

source.provision: CAA 2001 s 51A(5): the maximum allowance of £1,000,000, made permanent from 1 April 2023

rules.verifierNote: Check the £1,000,000 annual investment allowance limit and the date it applies from, and the Finance Act that made it permanent. The platform scales it by days/365 for a period shorter than 12 months (CAA 2001 s 51E); a period spanning a change of limit is refused, not apportioned (s 51B-51D style transitional rules are not modelled).

source.provision: CAA 2001 s 56(1) (main pool 18%) and s 104D (special rate pool 6% from April 2019)

rules.verifierNote: Check the main pool rate (18%) and the special rate (6%, reduced from 8% for chargeable periods from 1 April 2019; s 104D). The platform scales the allowance by days/365 for a period shorter than 12 months (s 56(3)); hybrid rates for a period spanning a change are not modelled.

source.provision: CAA 2001 s 56A: small pools allowance where unrelieved expenditure is £1,000 or less

rules.verifierNote: Check the £1,000 small pools limit (main and special rate pools only) and its reduction for a period shorter than 12 months. The platform claims it whenever it applies; a claim is optional in law and disclaiming is not modelled.
